_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Running work discards finished subagent rows when the panel closes. The test seeded a conversation at /c/rw-finishhelper. "The strip" is '[aria-label="Running work"]', "the toggle" is its [data-testid="running-work-toggle"], and "the row" is the strip's ".running-work-agent".
1. Navigate to /c/rw-finishhelper and wait up to 30s for [data-testid="message-input"] to be visible.
2. Fill the message input with "subagent: finishhelper bash: sleep 120" and click [data-testid="send-button"].
3. The toggle should come to contain "finishhelper" (wait up to 30s). Click the toggle.
4. The row should contain "finishhelper".
5. Call "cancelSubagent" (cancels the subagent through the API); it should return "ok".
6. The row's ".running-work-agent-time" should come to have exactly the text "Finished" (wait up to 15s).
7. Click the toggle. The strip should disappear (count 0).
